ke-colonial.title: Flag of the Kenya Colony
desc: - The Kenya Colony (1921–1963) used a British Blue Ensign defaced with a red lion — the colonial flag before independence
- **Construction:** a Blue Ensign with the colonial badge of Kenya in the fly half
trivia:
- Kenya was a British colony from 1895 to 1963
- The Union Jack represented British colonial rule
- Kenya gained independence in 1963
